scope: Decimal entry in combined payroll payments, management application only
cause: Controlled number inputs can discard a trailing decimal separator before cents are entered; the existing decimal sanitizer was already accepting comma and point.
changes: Use text inputs with decimal inputMode in both monthly settlement and pending-settlement payment forms
Preserve intermediate decimal input and normalize comma to point using the existing shared sanitizer
Compare combined allocations in integer cents and retain explicit save/confirmation actions

checks: Typing comma or point after the integer does not clear the field
Incorrect allocation cents keep payment disabled
Negative amounts, exponent notation and excessive precision remain rejected
Both payment allocations and both cash debits preserve exact cents
Reload does not duplicate payment records
No horizontal overflow in tested payroll views
verification.deviceTesting: Chrome desktop and mobile emulation; not physical-device keyboard testing
verification.initialSetupIssue: Docker was initially stopped; started the local runtime and reran all listed checks successfully
